extensionDescription.message: Farm Twitch and Kick drops through normal browser sessions, visible muted tabs, and optional low-resource mode.

promoTagline.message: Farm Twitch & Kick drops on autopilot.

settingsLanguageDescription.message: Choose the language used by the popup and extension notifications.

settingsSectionAdvancedActionsDescriptio.message: Import, export, or reset Lurkloot settings.

waitingEligibleStream.message: No eligible live stream is currently available for this campaign

watchingPausedHint.message: Watching paused. Toggle to resume drop farming.

hideTipsDescription.message: Remove helpful tips from the main popup.

inPagePanelTitle.message: Show panel on Twitch and Kick

inPagePanelDescription.message: Adds a Lurkloot button to twitch.tv and kick.com that opens this popup in a panel on the page.

tipCampaignPriority.message: Drops take priority over the Idle Watchlist. Drag campaigns by the grip to set their farming order.

tipMissingCampaigns.message: Missing a campaign? Check your platform's Drops inventory, then review campaign filters in Settings.

tipCategorySelection.message: Only farming certain games? Turn off ‘Farm all categories’ in platform settings and choose your categories.

tipIdleWatchlist.message: Drops stay first priority. The Idle Watchlist watches selected channels when no eligible drops are available.

tipTablessMode.message: Tabless mode uses fewer resources and falls back to a muted tab when needed.

tipCli.message: Prefer running without an extension? Lurkloot is also available as a Docker-based CLI.

tipFeedback.message: Found a bug or have an idea?

tipExcludedCampaigns.message: Excluded a campaign by mistake? Restore excluded campaigns from Drops settings.

tipTranslations.message: Translations are maintained automatically with AI. Help improve them on GitHub.

noActivity.message: No activity recorded yet. Press refresh to run a check.

noDiagnostics.message: No diagnostics recorded yet. They appear as the extension works.

pauseManualDescription.message: Stop farming while you have a stream open and are watching yourself.

autoStartDescription.message: Begin farming as soon as the extension loads.

notificationsDescription.message: Alerts when rewards are ready or campaigns finish.

rewardEarnedDescription.message: Notify when a drop reward is claimable.

noDropsLeftDescription.message: Notify when all active campaigns are exhausted.

dropsSettingsDescription.message: Claiming, eligibility, priorities, and campaign visibility.

autoClaimDescription.message: Claim earned drop rewards automatically when they become available.

campaignPriorityDescription.message: How campaigns are chosen to farm. Priority list only farms just the campaigns you've manually reordered; the others pick among all campaigns. Limit which categories are farmed per platform under Platform settings.

idleWatchlistSettingsDescription.message: Fallback channels used when no eligible drops are available.

idleWatchlistFallbackOnlyTitle.message: Prioritize drops over the Idle Watchlist

idleWatchlistFallbackOnlyDescription.message: Leaves an Idle Watchlist channel as soon as an eligible drop becomes available. When off, keeps watching it until it goes offline.

preferKnownChannelsTitle.message: Prefer followed and Idle Watchlist channels

preferKnownChannelsDescription.message: When a drop is available on several channels, picks one you follow or listed in your Idle Watchlist over an unfamiliar one.

platformSettingsDescription.message: Automation and channels for one provider. Switch between Twitch and Kick.

farmingTabsDescription.message: Controls for video-tab farming. Tab-specific controls are disabled while tabless low-resource mode is enabled.

tablessDescription.message: Farm via lightweight watch signals instead of a video tab. Twitch uses watch heartbeats; Kick uses a viewer connection. Falls back to a tab automatically if it stops earning.

tablessFallbackFailureLimitDescription.message: Open a video tab after this many consecutive failed tabless watch signals.

tablessFallbackFailureLimitDisabledReaso.message: Enable tabless low-resource mode to change this setting.

kickPageContextRecoverySuccessesDescript.message: Close an extension-opened Kick fallback page after this many successful refresh cycles.

kickPageContextRecoverySuccessesDisabled.message: Enable Kick to change this setting.

autoCloseTabsDescription.message: Automatically close when the extension is idle (no drops to farm or no streamers to watch).

muteTabsDescription.message: Keep drop and Idle Watchlist tabs muted while farming.

keepVideosUnmutedDescription.message: Keeps page video players unmuted while the browser tab is muted.

tablessDisabledReason.message: Disabled while tabless low-resource mode is enabled.

adFocusDescription.message: Ad countdowns freeze in background tabs. Briefly focus the farming tab while an ad plays so it counts down, then restore your previous tab.

advancedDescription.message: Only change these if you know what you are doing — they control low-level scheduler and logging behavior.

schedulerIntervalDescription.message: How often campaign and streamer status refreshes.

postClaimHandoffDescription.message: After claiming a drop, briefly check for the next reward in the campaign instead of waiting for the next scheduled cycle. Twitch only.

postClaimHandoffIntervalDescription.message: How long to wait between checks for the next reward.

postClaimHandoffMaxDescription.message: Give up and return to the regular schedule after this long.

deadlineSafetyMarginDescription.message: Extra minutes required before farming a reward.

deadlineSafetyMarginDisabledReason.message: Enable deadline filtering to change the safety margin.

skipUnfinishableRewardsTitle.message: Skip rewards that cannot be completed

skipUnfinishableRewardsDescription.message: Do not farm rewards when their remaining watch time exceeds the time before their deadline.

campaignRejectionExcluded.message: This campaign is excluded from farming.

campaignRejectionUpcoming.message: This campaign has not started yet.

campaignRejectionCompleted.message: All rewards in this campaign are complete.

campaignRejectionUnlinkedDisabled.message: Farming campaigns without a linked account is disabled.

campaignRejectionTwitchLinkRequired.message: Account linking is required for this Twitch campaign.

campaignRejectionCategoryFiltered.message: This campaign does not match the selected categories.

campaignRejectionPriorityNotSelected.message: This campaign is not in the priority list.

campaignRejectionNoRewards.message: This campaign has no farmable rewards.

campaignRejectionNoUnclaimedRewards.message: This campaign has no unclaimed rewards.

campaignRejectionPrerequisites.message: $1 is waiting for an earlier reward or requirement.

campaignRejectionInsufficientTime.message: $1 cannot be completed before its deadline.

campaignRejectionActionRequired.message: $1 requires an action other than watching.

campaignRejectionNoFarmableReward.message: No reward in this campaign can currently be farmed.

farmOnPlatform.message: Farm drops and watch Idle Watchlist channels on $1.

idleWatchlistEditHint.message: Edit it from the Idle Watchlist tab after selecting $1.

autoClaimChannelPointsDescription.message: Claim channel-point bonuses while farming this platform.

strictCampaignAvailabilityDescription.message: Only farm a campaign on channels Twitch lists it for. Twitch often omits farmable campaigns, so this can leave drops unfarmed.

autoClaimChallengesDescription.message: Claim Kick's daily challenge reward once its watch-time goal is met.

excludedChannelsDescription.message: Campaign farming will skip these streamers.

categoryModeDescription.message: Farm every $1 category, include only the categories you select, or exclude them.

includeCategoriesInstruction.message: Only these categories are farmed on $1.

excludeCategoriesInstruction.message: Every $1 category is farmed except these.

noCategoriesSelected.message: No categories selected — nothing will be farmed on $1. Add categories below.

noCategoriesExcluded.message: No categories excluded — every $1 category will be farmed. Add categories below to skip them.

activityLogLevelsDescription.message: Choose which levels are recorded in the Activity log. Errors are always kept.

farmUnlinkedTitle.message: Farm campaigns without a linked account

farmUnlinkedDescription.message: When off, campaigns that need you to link your account are skipped. Platform requirements can still require linking when this is on.

farmSubscriptionTitle.message: Farm campaigns that require a subscription

farmSubscriptionDescription.message: When off, campaigns whose rewards need a channel subscription are skipped.

dropsListFilterDescription.message: Choose which campaigns are shown in the Drops list. A campaign with a claimable reward always stays visible.

dropsListFilterLockedHint.message: Always shown while you're farming these campaigns.

forgetExcludedDescription.message: Clear every campaign you excluded from farming.

notificationChallengeReward.message: You won a $1 card from your $2 challenge.

notificationNoDropsLeftMessage.message: $1 has no eligible drops to farm.

screenshotHeroHeadline.message: Farm drops while you do anything else.

screenshotHeroSubcopy.message: Auto-claim from your own logged-in session. No passwords.

screenshotExtrasSubcopy.message: Channel points, Kick challenges, and 2-minute drops — also claimed for you. An idle watchlist when nothing is left to farm.

screenshotExtrasFlashMeta.message: Kick · picked up as they land

screenshotEasyPinSub.message: Keep the popup one click away.

screenshotEasyProfitSub.message: It farms. You do other things.

screenshotSettingsSubcopy.message: Priorities, games, tabless mode, auto-claim — per platform.

screenshotUpdatedSubcopy.message: Frequent releases as Twitch and Kick change — and open to ideas and improvements.

screenshotUpdatedBrowsersSub.message: Chrome Web Store listing. Same extension.

updateNoticeBody.message: See what's new and what changed.

rateNudgeBody.message: A quick review on the Chrome Web Store helps a lot.

cliExportDescription.message: Run drop farming on a server or in Docker with the Lurkloot CLI, using this browser's logged-in session.

cliExportHint.message: Exports your Twitch and Kick session tokens so the CLI's “login --import” can reuse them. Keep the file private — anyone with it can use your sessions.

cliExportConfirm.message: This downloads your Twitch and Kick session tokens to a file. Anyone with that file can act as you on those sites. Continue?

settingsExportHint.message: Save your settings to a file, or load them on another browser. Never includes your Twitch or Kick login.

settingsImportConfirm.message: This replaces your current settings with the ones from the selected file. Continue?

settingsImportFailed.message: That file isn't a valid Lurkloot settings export.

settingsExportFailed.message: Lurkloot couldn't export your settings. Try again.

factoryResetHint.message: Erase all Lurkloot settings, farming progress, and activity history. Your Twitch and Kick accounts stay signed in.

factoryResetConfirm.message: This stops farming, closes tabs opened by Lurkloot, and permanently erases all Lurkloot data. Twitch and Kick stay signed in.

factoryResetFailed.message: Lurkloot couldn't reset completely. Try again.

diagnosticLoggingDescription.message: Record additional technical details that can help diagnose problems. Normal activity is always kept.

activityChallengeClaimed.message: Claimed a $1 card from the $2 challenge

criticalFailureBodyNoProgress.message: Repeated errors and no drop progress for a long time. Something on this platform likely changed and the extension can no longer earn drops.

criticalFailureBodyTabChurn.message: A tab kept reopening over and over. Reopening has been stopped so you can use your browser normally, and farming is paused for this platform.

criticalFailureClipboardFallback.message: Could not copy automatically. Select and copy this, then open an issue.

activityPageContextOpened.message: Opened a background context on $1 because $2.

activityPageContextClosed.message: Closed the background context on $1 because $2.

activityPageContextReasonManagedContextU.message: the previous background context was unusable

activityPageContextCloseReasonUserTabAva.message: an existing Kick tab became available

activityReasonPlatformBackoff.message: the platform is temporarily backing off

activityReasonCampaignIneligible.message: the campaign is no longer eligible

activityReasonNoProgress.message: the channel earned no drop progress

activityReasonHigherPriorityIdleWatchlis.message: a higher-priority Idle Watchlist channel became available

clearActivityFailed.message: Could not clear activity history. Try again.

copyActivityLogFailed.message: Could not copy the log. Try again.

exportAllDiagnosticsFailed.message: Could not export the log. Try again.

compatibilityTwitchProfileDescription.message: Choose a bundled Twitch profile or let Lurkloot select it automatically.

compatibilityKickProfileDescription.message: Choose a bundled Kick profile or let Lurkloot select it automatically.

compatibilitySectionDescription.message: Only change these if Twitch or Kick is not working; they can help work around platform issues.

compatibilityTwitchHeartbeatDescription.message: Override the bundled Twitch watch heartbeat.

compatibilityTwitchInventoryDescription.message: Override the bundled Twitch inventory query.

compatibilityKickClaimDescription.message: Override the bundled Kick account-link handling.

compatibilityOverrideWarning.message: Manual compatibility overrides are active. They may stop working when platforms change.

authSignInMissing.message: Sign in to continue farming drops.

authSignInRejected.message: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again to continue.

authBrowserProfileBlocked.message: Kick rejected this browser profile. Signing in alone may not resolve it.

authCredentialCheckUnavailable.message: Your browser session could not be checked. Lurkloot will retry automatically.

authNetworkTemporarilyUnavailable.message: The network is temporarily unavailable. Lurkloot will retry automatically.

authPlatformTemporarilyUnavailable.message: The platform is temporarily unavailable. Lurkloot will retry automatically.

watchTabClosedPauseDetail.message: You closed the farming tab, so Lurkloot stopped farming here.

manualWatchPauseDetail.message: Farming is paused while you’re watching a stream yourself. Pause it, close it, or switch away from that tab to resume automatically on the next check.
